Notification

Our beloved Prophet Muhammad S.A.W.W was Rahmatul Lil Aalamin and a perfect model of tolerance, forgiveness, kindness and patience. In today's world, where we are connected to all our fellow beings through various means of communication, we are in dire need to follow our beloved Prophet S.A.W.W in these qualities.

In this connection, upon the directives of the honorable Vice Chancellor, a Seerat Conference has been arranged under the title:

سیرت نبویﷺ کی روشنی میں صبر و برداشت کی اہمیت اور اس کی بحالی

Speaker | Dr. Muhammad Zubair, Assistant Professor, Department of Islamic Studies, AWKUM
Venue | Central Library, Garden Campus, AWKUM
Date | August 27, 2026
Time | 11:00 am
Organizer | Department of Islamic Studies

All faculty/staff and students are requested to attend the conference.
